method: Executed the lesson Python fence and tracked LangChain reproduction under pinned Python 3.14.7 / langchain-core 0.3.63; enforced a <=70-character code line contract, rejected an unsupported inspect target clearly, and checked output categories, placement, inspect-derived locations, version scope, pinned-script upgrade boundary, metadata, and evidence wiring.
limitations: This validates only the local examples and pinned langchain-core version; an unchanged pinned script does not detect upstream changes. A new release must be installed in a separately updated environment and the assertions rerun. It does not establish general learning-value rankings or production behavior.
Production rendering was checked at 1300px in light and dark themes; the only initial console error was the existing favicon.ico 404.
